project_info.theme: Viettel connectivity bundle combining World Cup 2026 viewing, home internet, TV, and security camera perks
project_info.color_palette: Viettel Red, Soft Pink, White, Multicolor Sports Stripes

main_subject.detail: A product-offer poster featuring a floating white indoor security camera on the upper-right of a large pink offer card, topped by a partial FIFA football and diagonal multicolor stripes on a bright red background.
main_subject.style: Bold retail-offer graphic with sports-season energy, glossy product cutout, and rounded promo-card layout.

items: Top Left: Bright red background crossed by dark red, purple, lime, and green diagonal stripes.

Bottom Right: Empty extension of the promo card and product area.
Center/Background: Large red pill title area inside the pink card reading the main bundle offer.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean product highlights, saturated sports colors, and sharp rounded-card contrast.

technical_specs.render_style: Graphic retail offer poster with photoreal product cutouts

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality telecom bundle offer poster for Viettel. Centerpiece is a large pink rounded promo card over a bright red sports-themed background, highlighting a free security camera and cloud offer, with a white indoor camera product cutout and a partial FIFA football above. Surrounding elements: diagonal multicolor stripes, headline 'TẶNG CAMERA AN NINH + CLOUD 01 NGÀY 0Đ TRỌN ĐỜI', bullets about TV360 World Cup 2026, 1 Gbps internet, 130+ TV channels, and fee line 'Phí hòa mạng: 400.000 đồng'. Technical style: graphic retail offer poster with photoreal product cutouts, bright promo lighting, saturated sports energy, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
